trap.label: ever / never
trap.wrong: Did you ever visit a museum abroad?
trap.right: Have you ever visited a museum abroad?
trap.why: Em português 'você já visitou' admite o pretérito perfeito simples; para experiências de vida sem data, o inglês pede have + particípio.

opts: She has met a famous singer.
She met a famous singer last year.
She was meeting a famous singer.

fix.wrong: My cousin have been to Chile.
fix.right: My cousin has been to Chile.

rewrite.prompt: Pergunta com ever: “You have climbed a mountain.”
rewrite.answer: Have you ever climbed a mountain?

rewrite.prompt: Negativa com never: “I have driven a truck.”
rewrite.answer: I have never driven a truck.
